verified.subject: chemistry
verified.quote: In 1993, Pfizer Inc. developed a green synthesis route for sertraline (Zoloft) that cut solvent use by 200 kg per kg of product, eliminated four hazardous reagent steps, and reduced process waste by 60%
verified.problem: The EPA award account does not support these dates, units and percentages. It describes a different set of process improvements.
verified.correct: In 2002 Pfizer won the EPA award for combining three steps, replacing four solvents with ethanol, improving yield and removing substantial titanium-related waste. Remove the unsupported 1993,200kg, four hazardous steps and60% figures.

verified.subject: chemistry
verified.quote: replacing a stoichiometric titanium reagent with a catalytic palladium-based catalyst in one key step eliminated an entire waste stream and reduced metal waste by 85%
verified.problem: This conflates separate imine-formation and reduction changes, and adds an unsupported85% figure.
verified.correct: Ethanol and product solubility drove imine formation without titanium tetrachloride. A more selective palladium catalyst improved the subsequent reduction.

verified.subject: biology
verified.problem: The sclera is collagen-rich connective tissue, not bone.
verified.correct: Axial elongation involves remodelling of the collagen-rich sclera. Corrective optics do not simply shorten an elongated eyeball.

verified.subject: biology
verified.quote: Teens and up; not for young children or frequent eye infections
verified.problem: A blanket exclusion of children is false.
verified.correct: Some children can use prescribed contact lenses with appropriate supervision and hygiene. Suitability is individual.

verified.subject: biology
verified.problem: The definition of diffusion is followed by a claim that excludes water removal through ultrafiltration or osmosis.
verified.correct: Small solutes diffuse. Haemodialysis removes extra water by pressure-driven ultrafiltration; glucose-based peritoneal dialysis uses osmotic water movement.

verified.subject: biology
verified.quote: it contains glucose at blood concentration, so glucose has no gradient to follow.
verified.problem: This unqualified vocabulary example is not true of glucose-containing peritoneal dialysate.
verified.correct: Scope this example to haemodialysis. Peritoneal fluid often has extra glucose to create an osmotic water gradient.

verified.subject: biology
verified.problem: The requested ANZDATA2024 report, Table1.11, gives glomerular disease19% and hypertension/renal vascular disease12% among Australian newKRT patients in2023.
verified.correct: For2023 newKRT patients inAustralia, diabetic kidney disease was36%, glomerular disease19%, and hypertension/renal vascular disease12%. Keep cause-of-KRT separate from all diabetes co-morbidity.

verified.subject: biology
verified.quote: End-stage renal disease is reached when GFR falls below 15 mL/min
verified.problem: The staging threshold is indexed to1.73squaremetres of body surface area.
verified.correct: Kidney failure stageG5 uses eGFR below15mL/min/1.73m2. Keep the indexed unit and distinguish chronic staging from any single low measurement.
